original.target_description: Tsay, The vision heuristic, Experiment 1 (article-in-press p. 4): novices identifying winning chamber ensembles under video-only, sound-only, or video-plus-sound conditions; multiple chance, item-level, between-condition, and self-report tests. Supplied locator is only p. 4, with no study/outcome/contrast identifier; exact target unresolved.

n.sample_role: Target analytic unit/sample unresolved. Candidate 118 is the Experiment 1 participant total, not established analytic N for an identified contrast; separate item analysis averages competition trials.
n.exclusions: Target-specific exclusions not established. Footnote addresses gender nonreporting only; no N inferred from df and no group-count sum made.
n.location: Article-in-press p. 4, Experiment 1 Method/Participants and Results and discussion

es.location: Article-in-press p. 2, Table 1, Experiment 1; p. 4, Results and discussion

notes: Identity: supplied canonical text identifies The vision heuristic: Judging music ensembles by sight alone, Chia-Jung Tsay, Organizational Behavior and Human Decision Processes, DOI 10.1016/j.obhdp.2013.10.003. It is a primary research article with six experiments, methods/results, references and ten numbered pages, rather than an abstract or secondary account. This is the 2013 article-in-press version (xxx pagination), whereas the neutral reference is the final 2014 publication; title/author/DOI agree. Supplied source_pdf_path is null; no PDF was opened, acquired or rendered. Only n_o and es_value_o are assigned; replication, original p, and reported_success are placeholders. Locator p. 4 identifies Experiment 1 but not a unique test. Candidates on p. 4 include video-only versus chance t(40) = 4.28, p < .001; sound-only versus chance t(33) = 2.71, p = .011; item analysis t2(14) = 4.24, p = .001; video-plus-sound versus chance t(42) = 1.50, p = n.s.; and the self-report chi-square. Table 1 p. 2 explicitly prints Cohen’s d = 1.16 for Experiment 1 V versus A, with t(73) = 4.90, p < .001. That is a candidate printed Cohen’s d, not an established match to the unspecified target. Other between-condition contrasts also appear in Table 1. No candidate selected by metric or numeric matching. The 118-participant total is not assigned to a target test. No analytic N arithmetic or effect conversion performed.
